classification_policy.precedence: Incomplete coverage/outcomes => INCONCLUSIVE with separate conditional diagnosis; complete negative known expectancy => NO ECONOMIC BASELINE PASS; positive but insufficient sample => INCONCLUSIVE; complete positive stable unconcentrated sample satisfying all fixed criteria => ECONOMICALLY_PROMISING_BASELINE. No automatic Optimization.

independent_day_contract: Following UNKNOWN day assumes FLAT conditionally, never broker reconciliation

signal_and_M15_contract.M15: Streaming completed valid M5 only; exact 3 children, MSK wall-clock quarter-hours wholly in one window; release start+20. Latest nominally available parent and its two immediate predecessors only. Known M5 gap invalidates context immediately, even before incomplete parent release; three new complete parents required. No stale fallback.
signal_and_M15_contract.entry: One full waiting M5 then next Open; no future M15 recheck and no Open reference confirmation. Only adverse Stop geometry, >=4 historical ticks and common Open grid. Context state frozen at signal.
signal_and_M15_contract.exit: Unchanged core Stop-first/gap, no entry-bar Take, 120 calendar minutes, session end-5 and <=17:00, no overnight.
signal_and_M15_contract.reserve: At least 35 minutes to actual mandatory flat: min(window.end-5min,17:00). Common reserve adapter receives 40min for windows ending before 17:00, 35min for later windows; the five-minute common session buffer is not counted as holding reserve.
signal_and_M15_contract.selection: Initial structural hypothesis supplied by user, not selected using this Baseline P&L. One fixed configuration; no later economic tuning.
signal_and_M15_contract.signal: Exactly two immediately preceding opposite-color M5; second close moves >=1 tick against trend. Separate trend-color M5 closes >=1 tick beyond correction 2 high/low. Strict HH/HL or LH/LL on 3 available M15; no indicators.
signal_and_M15_contract.stop: Fixed min low / max high of both corrections and signal plus one adverse tick.
signal_and_M15_contract.target: Shared FULL_NET_C1_R; d=3s+8t outward tick rounding. Planned/actual net/net and gross-risk-normalized net_R_c1 reported separately.
signal_and_M15_contract.unknown: Missing waiting rejects without submission. Missing entry Open means UNKNOWN possible fill; missing exposed path UNKNOWN. Current day blocked; subsequent days conditional FLAT, no proven annual equity.
